translations.web: saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.’
translations.bsb: “Sir,” they said, “we remember that while He was alive that deceiver said, ‘After three days I will rise again.’
translations.kjv: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.
